magic_tall_letter_skyline.how: Seven tall letters move into a row (stage evening for the orange sky); small yellow box windows show in their sticks one by one; acorn path along the tops and drops into the squirrel paws.

magic_thank_you_cards_bloom.how: Each card moves into an envelope, then grows into a pop-up flower shape (grow 0.2 to 1) with six petals each showing a word; folds back (grow 0.2) and moves to the helper.

magic_theater_curtain_rises.how: stage_curtain move up in 3 s; lamp kinds fade up one at a time (1 s apart); two sign cards per word twin pop above the stage; then both glow with highlight.

magic_twin_letters_dance.how: Pairs hop off the train_car (0.3 s apart), reparent each pair to a group and spin the group slowly in a circle down the track; each pair highlights as its name is sung.

magic_twin_twirl.how: Each pair reparent to a group: move up 0.4 m, spin 1 turn slowly (2 s), settle on the shelf; a shared word card shows below the pair, highlight softly.

magic_voice_box_rainbow.how: Meter (battery_meter) fills; Robo chest panel paints red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple slowly (0.5 s apart); a soft chime (sound); then feel happy and say Splash.

magic_voices_take_color.how: Gray page: as each speaker line is spoken (say), emphasize it with a marker-pen color for that speaker; stay lit until the end, so colors ripple down the page.

magic_weather_board_comes_alive.how: Board props: cloud drift (move), sun grows 1 to 1.2 with lights warm, soft wind via wiggle on Duck, a kite lifts off the board and path loops round the studio.

magic_web_dew_sparkle.how: Web as stroke threads with small white sphere dew beads; for each key detail highlight its thread and paint its dew soft gold slowly (one per 2 s); finally all glow gently, sunrise lights.

magic_word_split_spark.how: At each fixed space a small gold spark burst pops (confetti); the two words hop apart (move 0.3); finished newspaper cards fold into paper_plane and path to the animals doors.

town_map_tracker.how: tracker kind with town style at the top left (hud); progress to the next place after each mission step, highlight the lit place; a badge pops at the finish.
